public.text: Phase 2 combines core registries, the LHR, terminology services, standards alignment, and consolidation. This may be too broad for a single phase and may encourage simultaneous implementation of several high-complexity components.
public.suggestedRevision: Require country-specific sequencing based on selected use cases, dependencies, governance readiness, data quality, architecture capacity, and investment constraints. Define minimum deliverables for each chosen component.
